crossRefs.note: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly…
He entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.
Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.
From there he arose, and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house, and didn’t want anyone…
As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

people.name: Capernaum
people.line: Town in Galilee; center of Jesus' ministry

translations.web: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was in the house.
translations.bsb: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum. And when the people heard that He was home,
translations.kjv: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
translations.asv: And when he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was noised that he was in the house.
